## Summary
- [ ] Purpose of the change (bug fix, feature, docs, chore)
- [ ] Linked issues/tickets
- [ ] High-level description of what changed

## Testing
- [ ] Tests added/updated
- [ ] Commands run (include output)

## Safety & Gates
- [ ] Changes respect Trinity 3 Locks (SSOT, Smart Gates, Audit Trail)
- [ ] Backwards compatible or migration notes included

## Checklist
- [ ] Documentation updated if needed
- [ ] Screenshots/artifacts attached if UI/UX changed
